description: A colorful sticker book is open on a bed, with a sheet of small white stickers on the right and a turtle scene on the left page. The right hand lifts a single sticker from the sticker sheet by peeling it up and away, while the left hand steadies the open book; then the right hand moves left and presses the sticker down onto the turtle picture, smoothing it into place as the left hand holds the page flat.
